title: Creatify Max
lede: Creatify Max is an AI agent for paid advertising that turns a product URL or brief into video ads, sets up Meta and TikTok campaigns, and keeps watching how they perform.

points: Video ads are generated with Creatify's own video models from a product link or a creative brief.
It sets up Meta and TikTok campaigns using the team's own naming conventions, budgets and targeting.
It monitors results around the clock, writes reports on the KPIs a team picks, and turns winning ads into briefs for the next round.
It keeps a memory of the team's playbook and feedback, so it adapts over time.
Nothing goes live until a person approves it.

sections.text: Marketers and paid media teams who spend their week on dashboards, reports and repeated campaign setup across ad platforms.
